name: mission-control
description: Long-term memory (Hippocampus) and the user's connected services (Reactor) for ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Mission Control gives ChatGPT a long-term memory that survives between conversations, and access to the services you have connected to your Mission Control account. ChatGPT recalls what you decided or prefer before answering, keeps what should outlive the conversation, and searches your connected tools before saying it cannot do something.
defaultPrompt: Remember that I prefer window seats on morning flights
What did we decide about the Lisbon trip?
Check my connected services for my spending this month
